_note: Slots for [brg_our-restaurants-hero]. Declared beside the fragment so a slot and its {token} ship in one commit. Generated into website/acf/ by `python3 kit/build-acf.py`; never hand-edit an acf.json. Slot names are underscore-only. `text`/`textarea` defaults are esc_html'd on fill, so write literal characters — a literal `&` and a literal `—`, never `&` or `—`, which would double-escape and render as visible entity text.\n\nTHE <h1> IS NOT WIRED. Whether the hero display headline should be an ACF field at all is Sean's design gate and is still open as of 2026-08-13 — Conti recommended wiring it, but a peer cannot grant a call the MANIFESTO puts at Sean's gate. Measured budget if it is approved: ~50 characters is a HINT and not a limit (careers-hero is already 4 lines at 42 characters where community-hero is 3 at 43 — same rule, same width, purely word lengths), 4 lines is the practical ceiling at 1440, and the hero doodles were pinned to the padding band first (b324b35) so a longer headline can no longer drag one into the type.
